scope: staging preparation and isolated recovery drills only

application.rollback_unit: immutable application image digest plus reviewed configuration fingerprint
preconditions: freeze promotion and preserve the candidate release evidence
select the previously approved image digest and configuration fingerprint
verify the target database migration inventory is compatible with the rollback image
run readiness, API contract, privacy, and observability checks in the isolated target
execution: deploy the previous image digest through the staging deployment mechanism
apply only the matching non-secret configuration reference
verify health/readiness and owner-scoped API behavior
record the rollback target, observed duration, and evidence hashes

configuration.secret_handling: configuration fingerprints and secret-manager references only; never copy secret values into evidence
configuration.rollback_target: the exact previously accepted candidate manifest, image digests, and configuration fingerprint

catalog.rollback_strategy: create a new staged immutable rollback snapshot from the prior superseded release
required_validation: source release is superseded and carries valid human review and validation evidence
rollback manifest checksum is recomputed and recorded
membership counts and release invariants are checked
activation uses the existing explicit catalog activation gate
prohibited_actions: promote engineering fixtures or non-production-eligible evidence

migrations.rollback: restore a compatible database backup and redeploy the compatible application; do not edit or reverse applied migration files
migrations.incompatibility: stop promotion and create a new forward migration after owner review

backup_restore.postgres: encrypted daily backup plus continuous WAL/PITR where supported
backup_restore.privacy: reapply deletion and retention tombstones before restored user data can serve traffic
